_about: The browser socket's wire contract. The server side is server/mockingbird/relay.py and routes_ws.py; the browser side is web/src/protocol.ts and web/src/interviewSession.ts. Tests on both sides read this file, so renaming a frame or a close code on one side fails the other side's tests. Audio is binary frames both ways: 16 kHz s16le mono, 640 bytes.
